description:
Calculates the earliest date a contracting authority may award a contract after informing the unsuccessful bidders under § 134 GWB. Intended for requests where the user asks when the standstill period ends or from which date the award may be made. Input `absendung` is the date the bidder information is sent after the evaluation (not the contract notice date). Standstill: 10 days for electronic dispatch, 15 days for postal dispatch (rules as of 2026-07-14). Returns two end dates because review bodies differ on weekends: without a weekend shift (VK Bund) and shifted to the next working day (OLG Bremen); the Federal Court of Justice has not decided the question. `zuschlag_praktisch_*` and `praxishinweis` give the first working day on which the award can be made (weekends and public holidays skipped; state holidays via the optional `land`). Tender and participation deadlines are calculated by calculate_tender_deadline.

Example user questions: "Wann endet die Wartefrist nach § 134 GWB?"; "Ab wann darf ich den Zuschlag erteilen?"; "Wie lange muss ich nach der Bieterinformation warten?"; "10 Tage Wartefrist — wann ist das genau?"

absendung.description: Date the § 134 GWB bidder information (Vorabinformation to unsuccessful bidders) is or was sent — not the contract notice date. ISO 2026-10-05 or German 05.10.2026.

elektronisch.description: Electronic or fax dispatch (10 days); false = postal (15 days). Default: true.

land.description: Optional federal state of the contracting authority; only used for the practical award date (state public holidays).

name: calculate_standstill_period
title: Wartefrist nach § 134 GWB berechnen
